description: droughtR is an R package for calculating stationary and non-stationary Standardized Precipitation Indices. Its README describes Normal, Gamma, zero-inflated Gamma and Weibull choices with generalised additive models to reduce bias in drought monitoring. Users provide precipitation series, accumulation period and distribution settings; outputs are drought-index time series for the supplied stations or grids. Geographic coverage follows the measurements and model domain. Its DESCRIPTION states MIT licensing, and source precipitation data retain their own terms. A limitation is that index values vary with reference period and distribution fit, and meteorological drought is not the same as reservoir or groundwater shortage. The model can supply drought-stress scenarios for irrigation and drinking-water simulation. The related ERA5 catalogue record can supply precipitation fields but not the drought-index fit. No rainfall data or package archive was downloaded.
inputs: Precipitation series and drought-index distribution settings
